description: An Express 5 app in TypeScript that sends email, SMS, and in-app notifications in one Courier send, and renders them in a <courier-inbox>.
rules: Use the @trycourier/courier SDK and read COURIER_API_KEY from the environment, on the server only.
Send email, SMS, and inbox in one client.send.message with routing method "all". Leave sms out of the channels when the user has no phone number.
Pass one Idempotency-Key per event, built from the saved event's id, such as task-assigned-<assignment id>.
Mint the inbox JWT with client.auth.issueToken for the user in the session, never a user id from the request.
Connect email and SMS providers in Courier instead of calling them directly.
